steps.code:
# Let's get all pages of friends to ensure we have the complete list
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total friends fetched: {len(all_friends)}")
print(all_friends)

steps.code:
# Count friends made since start of October last year (2022-10-01)
from datetime import datetime

start_date = datetime(2022, 10, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend['friends_since'])
    if friends_since >= start_date:
        count += 1

print(f"Number of friends made since start of October last year: {count}")
